strategy: retain existing formats and storage keys; no rewrite migration
changes: TypeScript names and explicit input aliases only

formats.guarantee: Keep event kinds, recordedSubSteps/subflow/subStep and identity; names do not grant authorization.
Topology and observed visits differ; incomplete coverage remains explicit; aliases do not rewrite records.
Host-data and branch snapshot only; does not restore a workflow cursor or credentials.

formats.owner: Kit validates; App owns exclusive durable store
formats.guarantee: Keep definition revision/task/step operation identity and old commitId; each new persist generates a new commitId. Unknown remains unknown.
Keep definitionId/taskId storage key, waitId/subject/submission/expiry/terminal state; never reopen or extend by renaming.

formats.owner: App CAS store and current authorization
formats.guarantee: Keep id/revision/activeId/expiresAtMs/versions; CAS revision is not a format version.

formats.writer: envelope version 1 with anchored native turns
formats.guarantee: Keep scope/protocol/model/endpoint, complete history anchors/native signatures and operation/remote/item identities. Unknown or unanchored versions reject.
Keep dispute/parent/content/policy/source revisions, wait/action/deadline/submission; waiting resolved does not mean accepted.
Canonical host projections use domainTool names; model-facing wire vocabulary is intentionally retained.

mixedVersionPolicy.oldWriterToCandidateReader: supported only within the existing accepted format contracts
mixedVersionPolicy.candidateWriterToOldReader: no new persisted writer format; do not infer general cross-version runtime compatibility
mixedVersionPolicy.unknownFormat: reject before a new external operation; no guessing, automatic reopen or silent conversion

conditionalSupplement: No new participant, resume or cancellation format until the collaboration supplement actually adopts and specifies it.
